scope: Proposition 7.2 (Multiplier identity) of the manuscript “A Charged Reduction of the Spacetime Penrose Inequality in Spatial Dimensions at Least Four” (preprints/A-Charged-Reduction-of-the-Spacetime-Penrose-Inequality-in-Spatial-Dimensions-at-Least-Four-October-5-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 260 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 3e5e445d305051a1), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 56. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There are a probability measure π on F∗, a nonnegative locally finite measure Λ on the active rays, and a nonnegative finite measure ζ on S, such that 2kωB′ − c ∫ F∗ a′ F (h) dπ(F) = ∫ C′ dΛ − ∫ S θ′ + dζ (7.11) for every compact test and every end prototype above.
